# Codexter

> Codexter is a free, browser-based coding school. It teaches programming through
> interactive lessons that pair reading with a live editor, a console, and
> self-checking exercises — no videos, no paywall, and no build setup. Everything
> runs client-side in the learner's browser.

Codexter covers 17 tracks and more than a hundred hands-on lessons spanning web
fundamentals, TypeScript, React, back-end and APIs, Python, data structures and
algorithms, Git, testing, DevOps, security, architecture, performance, and AI
agents. Progress, streaks, and badges sync to a free account, and learners can
compare scores on weekly leaderboards or form guilds.

## Curriculum

- [Interactive lessons](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/learn): 17 tracks of guided, runnable lessons across the full modern web stack.
- [Live playground](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/playground): a scratch editor for writing and running code outside the lessons.

## Practice and projects

- [Projects](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/projects): larger builds that combine lessons into shippable deliverables.
- [Portfolio](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/portfolio): a learner's completed work and certificates in one place.

## Community

- [Leaderboards](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/leaderboard): weekly, monthly, and all-time rankings by experience points.
- [Guilds](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/clans): small teams that pool experience and unlock collective rewards.

## Get started

- [Home](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/): an overview of the school and a way into the lessons.
- [Create a free account](https://codextorcybo4.freebuff.app/#/auth): save progress and sync it across devices.
